question: Could you give me an example of something you needed to remember before a recent outing?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “The bag of clean bibs, last week. I’d put it by the door, so that part was done, but then I started looking for my bus card and nearly went without the bag. My friend said, ‘Don’t forget the bibs.’ A bit embarrassing when it’s my job to bring them—I had washed them and everything, just hadn’t picked them up.”
